reasoning: Both meetings maintain identical policy tools (QE at $85B/month total, fed funds rate at 0-1/4%), the same unemployment threshold (6.5%) and inflation thresholds for forward guidance, and the same accommodative stance. The only material language change is the addition of 'as well as the extent of progress toward its economic objectives' to the asset purchase conditionality clause, which is a clarification of existing conditionality rather than a new regime — the Committee explicitly noted this was to make explicit what was already implicit in their reaction function.
key_quote: In determining the size, pace, and composition of its asset purchases, the Committee will continue to take appropriate account of the likely efficacy and costs of such purchases as well as the extent of progress toward its economic objectives.
